lines.en: I crawl up the trunk, hunting shade.

lines.zh: 夜里的森林，我飞得很低。
lines.en: At night I fly low through the forest.
I circle the lily of the valley.
My wings are speckled black and white.

lines.zh: 我贴着树皮飞，几乎看不见。
lines.en: I fly close to bark, nearly unseen.

lines.zh: 我贴着树干飞，斑纹混进去。
lines.en: I fly along the trunk, my markings blending in.
I choose the dark places to rest.
Slow wingbeats. Enough at night.
I settle on birch bark.

lines.zh: 我飞过的地方都是林子。
lines.en: I drift through the wood.
I smell the flowers' sweetness.
I patrol between two trees.

lines.zh: 夜色让我的斑纹更安全。
lines.en: Night makes my speckles safer.
I rest, then take off.
Not a straight line. Around the trees.
I glide over the dead leaves.

lines.zh: 我摊开翅膀，贴在树皮上。
lines.en: Wings spread, I lie against bark.
By day I try not to move.

lines.zh: 我的斑纹和树皮一个样。
lines.en: My markings match the bark.
I wait for deeper night.
The lily's scent calms me.

lines.zh: 我收起翅膀，只剩一条线。
lines.en: Wings folded, I am one thin line.

lines.zh: 森林里，我只是一片树皮。
lines.en: In the wood I am just bark.
I test the wind with my antennae.
A moth has no need of the sun.
A bird passes. I do not move.
I count the lines in the bark.
My life is short. I conserve it.
Dew is heavy tonight. I stay put.
I flatten my wings slowly.

lines.zh: 你看见的只是一块树皮。
lines.en: You see only bark.
Do not grab. I am quick.
I know that net in your hand.

lines.zh: 白天我不常出现，你运气好。
lines.en: I rarely show by day. Lucky you.
You stepped on the lilies.
I am on the tree at your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的斑纹让你看不清我。
lines.en: My speckles hide me from you.
There are many moths in this wood.

lines.zh: 我的斑纹贴在树皮上，你看漏了。
lines.en: My speckles blend into the bark, and you miss me.

lines.zh: 你见过和我一样的蛾吗？
lines.en: Have you seen a moth like me?
A small piece of wing is gone.
I fly a crooked circle.

lines.zh: 我的斑纹被抹掉了一块。
lines.en: A patch of my markings is smudged.
I drop to a leaf to rest.
It hurts. I can still fly.
I do not cry out. Moths do not.
A lot of wing dust came off.
I crawl two inches along the ground.

lines.zh: 树皮色的翅膀，被拍歪了。
lines.en: My bark-colored wings got knocked crooked.
I hide behind the bark.
Nectar? Lily of the valley is best.
That flower was picked too soon.
I do not eat fruit. Only nectar.
That one is too bright.

lines.zh: 把花放在树根旁，我过去。
lines.en: Set it by the roots and I will come.
There is no dew on your flower.
Too sweet. Not a real flower.
I feed only at night.
Hold still or my wings will touch you.
Thanks. This one is enough.
You touched me. I take off.

lines.zh: 我撞在树干上，掉了几片鳞。
lines.en: I hit the trunk and lose scales.

lines.zh: 你的指头比我的翅还宽。
lines.en: Your finger is wider than my wing.
I dodged. Barely.
Do not swat. You will knock off my dust.

lines.zh: 我贴着树皮绕开你的手。
lines.en: I hug the bark and slip around your hand.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，我的斑纹乱了。
lines.en: After the bump, my markings are askew.
You step back and I return to bark.
I am too light to make a sound.
You block the lilies of the valley; I go around.

lines.zh: 夜里，我们用气味找对方。
lines.en: At night we find each other by scent.

lines.zh: 我的卵会落在树叶背面。
lines.en: My eggs go on the underside of leaves.
The season is short. Be quick.
The caterpillar eats only leaves.

lines.zh: 你问蛾子这种问题，奇怪。
lines.en: Odd question for a moth.

lines.zh: 羽化之后，我们只剩几周。
lines.en: After emerging, we have weeks.

lines.zh: 我的同伴在林子的另一头。
lines.en: My kind are at the wood's far end.
Look away. My wings tire.
The eggs are small as dew.

lines.zh: 这一代之后，还有下一代。
lines.en: After this brood, another.

lines.zh: 这片叶子上的露，我喝一口。
lines.en: I sip the dew on this leaf.
I leave your dropped net alone.
A petal on the ground. A shame.

lines.zh: 我把卵挪到更安全的叶子。
lines.en: I move my eggs to a safer leaf.

lines.zh: 我用前足捧起一点花粉。
lines.en: I scoop pollen with my forelegs.
I do not drink the sugar water.
That cloth is too bright to hide on.

lines.zh: 我衔起一片枯叶，挪到暗处。
lines.en: I carry a dead leaf into the dark.

lines.zh: 拾取太费力气，我很少做。
lines.en: Carrying is costly. I rarely do it.
The specks on my wings look like pepper.
I saw your hand move.
I shift to the darker side.
The net is up. I fly.
You cannot pin a moth.
I head deeper into the wood.
One wingbeat and I change course.
The moment a light comes, I press back to the bark.
I fly low and slip under a leaf.
You broke a twig. I heard.
This time I move first.

lines.zh: 我绕着树转，你不容易看见。
lines.en: I circle the trunk, hard to see.

lines.zh: 我的斑纹在暗处更好用。
lines.en: My speckles work better in the dark.
The more you chase, the higher I go.
I pause to see where you are.
The wind helps me. Perhaps not you.
I shift between the crowns.
That sound at your ear was me.
I wait for you to lower the net.
The leaves under you are loud.

lines.zh: 我在这儿，只是你看不见。
lines.en: I am here. You just cannot see me.
My wing dust puffs into your face.
I bump your eye. Just once.
That barely counts as a blow.
I scratch the back of your hand.
Moths have tempers too.
I knocked your net askew.

lines.zh: 你揉眼睛的时候，我已经走了。
lines.en: By the time you rub your eyes, I am gone.

lines.zh: 这点劲儿，只够让你眨眼。
lines.en: Enough force to make you blink.
I land on your hand and leave.
Do not say I did not warn you.

lines.zh: 树皮上多了一小块斑点。
lines.en: One more speck on the bark.

lines.zh: 夜里，铃兰旁边有翅膀响。
lines.en: Wings by the lilies at night.
I emerge from a bark seam.

lines.zh: 你听见很轻的一声扇动。
lines.en: A very soft flutter.

lines.zh: 这片林子的蛾子多了一只。
lines.en: One more moth in this wood.
I open my wings against the trunk.
A speckle flashes in the moonlight.
I rise from under a leaf.

lines.zh: 铃兰旁边，我的翅膀先响。
lines.en: Beside the lilies, my wings sound first.
Pollen settles on my wings.

lines.zh: 火把靠近，我的触角先缩。
lines.en: The torch nears and my antennae curl first.
I tumble down from the tree.
Too much dew. My wings are wet.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹到另一棵树上。
lines.en: The blast blows me to another tree.
An arrow grazes my wingtip.
Magic makes my wings heavy.

lines.zh: 铃兰不流蜜，我的翅发沉。
lines.en: The lilies hold no nectar, and my wings grow heavy.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我的斑点全白了。
lines.en: Lightning flashes; my speckles go white.
No trees below. Only nothing.
